feeds.title: California Globetrotter
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Lorelei, I'm an expat living in Germany obsessed with adorable fairy tale towns, and castles. California Globetrotter's goal is to provide you, with useful tips and information for traveling Europe, also I will share here my expat opinions and experiences of living among the Germans.

feeds.title: MW Expat Blog
feeds.description: Read the MW-Expat blog if you are planning or have recently moved to Germany. You will find articles on German insurance, saving plans, and more. We are focused to help professional ex-pats with their insurance in Germany.

feeds.title: Expatrio
feeds.description: On Expatrio Blog, you will find stories about studying and working in Germany. Expatrio is an innovative company dedicated to providing a fully digital, trustworthy, customized, and straight-to-the-point service for expats. We built a customized solution allowing you to minimize bureaucratic processes associated with moving to Germany.

feeds.title: Alisa Jordan Writes
feeds.description: Hi, I am Alisa Jordan, I left my home city for Frankfurt to improve my foreign language skills and experience life abroad on a long-term basis. This platform shares my personal experiences of living abroad, learning the German language as well as things to do in Frankfurt and navigating life in Germany.

feeds.title: The British Berliner Blog
feeds.description: The British Berliner is a lifestyle expat travel blog about culture, history, travels around the world, Europe, and being British in Berlin. It will focus on a British girl from Manchester living in Berlin, her promotion of British-German life, culture, history, literature, theatre, style, Europe, travels around the world, what she does in normal everyday life and where she goes.

feeds.title: Berlin International Women's Club Blog
feeds.description: Berlin International Women's Club is an informal and friendly way to develop international friendships of all ages through a rich variety of activities including business lunches, sports, charity support work, and regular get-togethers. We offer you a community to meet women of all backgrounds.

feeds.title: Life in Düsseldorf
feeds.description: We are the city's first English-language publication dedicated to helping ex-pats settle in and live it up in their new home. We gather tips from locals, community groups, forums, and our own everyday adventures and provide them to you through our blogs for acquiring a best time in Germany.

feeds.title: Chasing Whereabouts
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Sankalp, a software engineer, and a travel enthusiast. Chasing Whereabouts is the place where I write about the beautiful countries of Europe. The travel stories are in the form of blogs and videos, highlighting the best discount available on flights, places, how to commute, free mobile applications to use in that location, cheap deals on attractions, gears we use, packing tips, and best spots for photography.

feeds.title: Fintiba Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, you can find everything you need to know about studying and living in Germany. If you are planning a move to Germany you will get all the relevant information in this blog. Fintiba is a company that was built to help international students. We are offering innovative tailor-made online solutions for international students and other groups who want to work or study in Germany.

feeds.title: British in Germany
feeds.description: British in German actively campaigns to protect the rights of UK citizens in Germany in collaboration with the Europe-wide citizens' coalition 'British in Europe' and 'The3million Coalition in the UK. We also inform and organize locally so that Britishers are kept up to speed on the negotiations, and can take action to ensure their rights.

feeds.title: My Life in Germany
feeds.description: Hi, I am Sindy. This blog is all about how I moved to Germany. Here I share my experiences along with important tips and tricks concerning studying and working, for Expats who live in Germany. Also, get information on finance, culture, food, life in Germany, and more.

feeds.title: Oddities and Ends
feeds.description: My name is Jessie, and I'm a 35-year-old American living in Wolfsburg, Germany with my husband. This blog originally started out as a place for me to share my opinions and occasionally post short stories. Now, it has evolved into a travel and expat/immigrant experience blog. Here, you will find posts on how life in Germany is awesome, embarrassing stories from my failed attempts to communicate with the natives, and travel stories.

feeds.title: A Bavarian Sojourn
feeds.description: This blog is written by Emma, a repatriated expat, sharing her experiences, and reviews for expats. Read the provided information, tips & tricks along with the photographs, related to travel, and more on her blog.

feeds.title: Packing my Suitcase
feeds.description: A Brazilian living in Germany started this travel family blog with the hope to share her expat life, and travel experiences. Find all the information related to German culture, food, tips, travel information, reviews, and more on her blog page.

feeds.title: Expat Care Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find multilingual informative articles for expats in Germany related to health, social, family, and work issues. We are focused to provide problem-solving content on ex-pat issues in English, Spanish and Italian language.

feeds.title: Expat Eye on Germany
feeds.description: Find 473,937,493 easy steps to becoming a German written by Linda O'Grady. After being chased out of Latvia by pitch fork-wielding locals Linda made her way to Berlin and created this blog page to document her findings on food, culture, life in Germany, and more.

feeds.title: City Starlings
feeds.description: City Starlings is an ex-pat blog for those living in Germany. The idea of City Starlings is to bring Munich alive, through the voices of locals and ex-pats alike. Whether you are just visiting or you plan on making Munich your home, this blog will provide useful tools and advice.

feeds.title: Not a Nomad Blog
feeds.description: My name is Monica. This is a travel photography blog by an American expat living in Berlin. On this blog, you will find writings about taking your career abroad, traveling the world part-time, & the expat experience. I aim to encourage those who are working abroad and interested in photography & traveling with my blogs.

feeds.title: BInGer
feeds.description: Read blogs about parenting abroad including parental leave in Germany, worst gifts for kids, how to travel with baby, birth gift list, and many more on the website.

feeds.title: Dubliner In Deutschland Blog
feeds.description: Just a girl from Dublin, Ireland, living in southern Germany with my German husband blogging about my experiences. The topics I cover in Dubliner In Deutschland Blog are ex-pat life, German food, German culture, parenting, daily life, travel and more.

feeds.title: Cheryl Howard
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Cheryl Howard a longtime traveler. This is the place where I write about my traveling experiences, unusual places, and things, and share unique itineraries for various destinations be it a food guide, pointers on where to sleep, what to do, and more.

feeds.title: The piri-piri lexicon
feeds.description: Hi, I am Annabelle, a mother raising two cross-cultural kids, wife, an ex-pat, linguist, and travel lover. Read about expat parenting, travel, and our multilingual and multicultural displaced family's adventures in the world on the Piri-Piri lexicon.

feeds.title: Erin at Large
feeds.description: I'm Erin, a Canadian freelance writer and editor currently based in southern Germany. I write about European travel stories for history & culture lovers. This blog aims to help you to get informed about how people used to live in Europe, museums, civilization, and more.

feeds.title: Laurie's Franconia
feeds.description: Hi, I am Laurie, an American horticulturist, writer, and storyteller currently staying in Franconia. Life in a Second Homeland with my family is the perfect mix of magic and misery. Read my blogs, and get cooking & travel tips, related resources, know the culture of Germany and more.

feeds.title: My Meena Life
feeds.description: Hello there! I'm Ava Meena. I created this blog to share, my insatiable love for travel, my time as an ex-pat in Germany, and much more. After being diagnosed with lupus, this blog has evolved to the point where I now create content about my life and travels with chronic illness.

feeds.title: Expatica
feeds.description: Get the latest English-language news in Germany covering both domestic and global current events, curated especially for ex-pats on Expatica. Expatica is an international media company that aims to provide specialised resources for expats, such as an expat online dating site, job and housing search tools, community pages for readers to post discussions, events and more.

feeds.title: Adventures of Steffi
feeds.description: Hi, my name's Steffi, I explore life & language as a first-time, unexpected expat. My aim with this blog is to provide an authentic, honest and humorous account of life in Germany. Here you can find stories related to exploring life in Germany along with my personal experiences and opinions.

feeds.title: The German Way & More » History & Culture Blog
feeds.description: German Way website provides insights into the rich variety of customs and attitudes found in German-speaking countries. We help you understand the cultures of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland by sharing information and experiences. Our guide is aimed at travelers, business people, students, and expats in German-speaking countries.
